label: randomWalkWithRestart.init_and_shuffle_neighbors
reason: Shuffle iterations were increased (1050 -> ceil(1050*1.01)) inside the per-movie initialization loop; this adds CPU work proportional to graph size and can noticeably affect latency on large graphs.

label: orama.searchMovies.hybridSearch
reason: Search limit increased (1000→1010), which can increase Orama hybrid search work and the amount of returned hit data (including vectors). This is likely the dominant contributor to latency and drives downstream work.
return_value_change: May return up to 10 additional hits due to the higher Orama `limit`, increasing downstream processing and potentially the returned array size.

label: searchMovies.postprocessHits.levenshteinOrder
reason: The increased hit count flows into candidate mapping, Levenshtein-based ordering, and Map construction. These are CPU/memory heavy and scale with the number of hits/candidates, so the bumped limit can noticeably increase time here.
return_value_change: May return a slightly larger ordered hit list because more upstream hits are available to order and filter.

label: rateLimiter.catch_429_handling
reason: New console.debug added in the rate-limit failure path; if rate limits are hit frequently, extra logging (especially with Error objects) can add noticeable CPU/serialization overhead and increase tail latency before responding 429.
